scope: Offline inspection of the accepted candidate kernel and installed userspace CLI; preparation of a private, strictly checked, no-selector next-boot observation template

kernel_source_and_binary_inspection.reason_for_limit: The accepted private candidate artifact was inspected; the current EFI binary was not available at the recorded path and no partition was mounted for this review
identified_candidate_writeReg_machine_se: Bounds-check the dword address against the MMIO mapping length
Store the caller's 32-bit value at the mapping plus four times the register index
Load a 32-bit word from the same mapping and index
Store the readback through the caller's output pointer
limits: This inspection covers identified functions in the candidate artifact, not a runtime kernel-memory read or proof of the complete dispatch path
It does not prove hardware write acceptance, physical mapping cache attributes, exclusive ownership, power readiness or a selector root cause

installed_CLI_inspection.qualification_of_prior_selector_words: The earlier zeros are words printed by the installed CLI. That branch did not independently validate the returned scalar count, so a complete reply shape must not be inferred from its printed readback alone.

findings: The ordinary non-VF SOC15 path resolves to WREG32/RREG32; in-range amdgpu_device accesses use dword-scaled direct MMIO
The RLCG/shadow paths remain conditional on VF/full-access predicates; this review does not establish them as a requirement for this target

The PSP firmware path still contains additional GFXHUB, golden-register, constants, RLC and CP initialization stages after RLC autoload completion; CP/RLC readiness observations do not certify all those stages
GRBM_SOFT_RESET and CP_SOFT_RESET_CNTL use GC base index 0; CP_ME_CNTL uses base index 1. The next observer checks these definitions rather than assuming one common segment.

future_session_changes: Fresh boot seconds and private session identity
Private checked-CLI path without replacing installed helpers
Reviewed whole-file SHA-256 arguments for TOC staging and IP firmware loads
